Once upon a time:
, there was a big mountain. On top of the mountain, there was a small house. In the house, a boy named Tom lived with his mom and dad. They were a happy family.
One day, Tom went for a walk near the mountain. He saw a big tree with a lot of birds. He saw a squirrel and wanted to play with it. His mom said, "No, Tom. The squirrel might not be nice." But Tom did not listen. He went to the mountain to play with the squirrel.
The squirrel was not nice. It bit Tom's hand. Tom cried and ran back to his mom. His mom hugged him and said, "I told you not to touch the squirrel." From that day on, Tom learned to listen to his mom and never went near the mountain again. The moral of the story is to listen to your parents and not to do things that can hurt you.

, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy loved to play with her soft toy cat. She would take the toy cat everywhere she went. One day, while playing outside, Lucy found a sharp rock. She thought it was special and wanted to keep it in her toy box.
Lucy was frightened that her toy cat might be in the sharp rock. She tried to hide the rock from her little brother, Tom. Tom wanted to play with the toy cat too. They both started to argue about where the sharp rock could be.
Lucy's mom heard them and came outside. She told them that the sharp rock was not safe for them to play with. Lucy and Tom listened to their mom and put the toy box back where it belonged. They learned that it is important to listen to their mom and to respect things that do not belong to them. And they played happily ever after.
